what: Claims plan-review staging matches the strict allowlist pattern already used for render-cache
scenario_or_breakage: [`scripts/design-log-publish.sh`](scripts/design-log-publish.sh) stages every regular file under `render-cache/` recursively (`find "$rc_root" -type f` then stage each); there is no basename/path allowlist comparable to only `.../findings-classification.tsv`
suggested_fix: Describe render-cache as full-tree staging with escape guard, and specify plan-review as the new strict allowlist (enumerate allowlisted paths plus explicit reject pass), or drop the equivalence claim

what: Reject unexpected files is not operationalized alongside find only allowlisted paths
scenario_or_breakage: An implementation could stage only matching `findings-classification.tsv` paths and never fail on `plan-review/round-1/debug.txt` or `findings-classification-v2.tsv`, diverging from Failure modes test intent (unexpected sibling rejected)
suggested_fix: Spell out a second `find` (or walk) under a resolved `plan-review` root and require every file path match `^plan-review/round-[0-9]+/findings-classification\\.tsv$` after relativization (or equivalent), else `larch_err` + `emit_publish_result false`

what: Only documents early exit when `plan-review/` is absent; not when the directory exists empty or has no `round-*` trees / no TSV
scenario_or_breakage: Implementer might treat zero allowlisted matches as an error or run a reject scan that errors on empty dirs
suggested_fix: State explicitly: empty `plan-review/`, no `round-*` dirs, or zero `findings-classification.tsv` matches is success (no `larch_err`); reserve errors for symlink wrong-type, path escape, or disallowed files present

what: Relative `RUN_DEST/...` layout is not tied to the same canonicalization and prefix checks used for `render-cache/`
scenario_or_breakage: Without `cd ... && pwd -P` plus `case "$f" in "$pr_root"/*)` (or equivalent), `find` output prefixes may not strip cleanly from user-provided `DESIGN_TMPDIR` forms, or symlinked `plan-review` could confuse root-relative staging
suggested_fix: Mirror the render-cache block: resolve `plan_root=$(cd "$DESIGN_TMPDIR/plan-review" && pwd -P)`, reject symlink/wrong-type like lines 279-287, enumerate from `pr_root`, strip `${pr_root#/}` → `plan-review/...` or strip design tmpdir prefix consistently, validate each path stays under `pr_root` before `design_publish_stage_file "$f" "$RUN_DEST/$rel"`

what: Says find uses an exact glob; `find -path` uses patterns, not shell globs, and needs careful anchoring
suggested_fix: Replace glob wording with a normative `find` predicate (e.g. `-path` segments) and note `*` does not cross `/` in GNU find
